execution_profile.threads: one serial executor per private instance; no shared-memory atomics
execution_profile.host_authority: No implicit WASI or ROS interfaces or operations; the deployment grants each explicitly.

static.ownership: Consumer memory, stack, allocator, table and exception runtime; pointer ABI remains within that instance.

dynamic_same_memory_preload.reason: The C++ shared allocator, stack, table, initialization and cross-module exception ABI is not implemented. Ordinary core-preload with separate memories is not this model.

independent_multi_memory.reason: C++ lowering and copy/ownership/exception boundaries for private heap plus communication memory are not implemented. WAT runtime tests do not qualify this C++ port.

native_boundary.numerical_reference: Original native library only supplies differential test results; it is never an execution fallback.

retained_audited_infrastructure: native ROS host interface and Gateway
rclcpp transport node/executor and ROS message type support
system_boundary: official simulator physics and intrinsic device actuators
official_model_integration.interpretation: Native ROS/RMW/DDS communication is retained as the trusted authorization and audit boundary. Guest business logic crosses that boundary under its own module authority; it must not bypass it through guest DDS or raw networking.

qualification_requirements: Exact upstream source and complete adaptation patch
Original-native versus adapted-native versus identical Wasm bytecode comparisons
Interpreter and LLVM JIT on each target architecture
Explicit permissions, denial before native effects and private-instance isolation
Official-model tests with actual native/guest executable identities
Native x86_64 timing separated into compile/startup and steady computation; QEMU supplies correctness only

adaptations.change: Remove only two rclcpp::Duration convenience overloads. Keep seconds, int64 nanoseconds and std::chrono overloads.
adaptations.compatibility: API subset; not drop-in source compatibility for callers of the removed overloads.

adaptations.change: Replace RealtimeThreadSafeBox with an explicitly serial value box.
adaptations.compatibility: Equivalent only in the declared serial profile. Does not preserve concurrent dynamic-gain-update or priority-inheritance behavior.

adaptations.change: Retain original computation, gain checks, anti-windup, C++ exceptions and formatted diagnostics.
adaptations.compatibility: Checked by differential tests; finite tests do not establish every possible input.

adaptations.change: Own the actual C++ object and translate exceptions into status codes at the same-instance C boundary.
adaptations.compatibility: Raw pointers cannot cross independent module memories.

not_migrated: PidROS node wrapper, ROS parameter handling and subscriptions
Concurrent realtime gain updates and native priority-inheritance scheduling
Complete package/plugin lifecycle and ROS API compatibility
